proposal.summary: The Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload Contact Form 7 5.0.6.1 WordPress plugin contains a remotely exploitable relative path traversal via the upload_name argument in admin-ajax.php; the exploit has been publicly disclosed.
proposal.affected_product: Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload Contact Form 7 5.0.6.1 (admin-ajax.php: unknown function)

AV.quote: It is possible to launch the attack remotely.

C.quote: The manipulation of the argument upload_name leads to relative path traversal.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain the vulnerable plugin source (admin-ajax.php) and reproduce the upload_name handling to confirm path traversal, then create an authoritative technical advisory and coordinate mitigations.

evidence_quotes.quote: A vulnerability was found in Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload Contact Form 7 5.0.6.1 on WordPress.
Affected is an unknown function of the file admin-ajax.php.
The manipulation of the argument upload_name leads to relative path traversal.
It is possible to launch the attack remotely.
The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.
The identifier of this vulnerability is VDB-222072.
